mapper.select: SELECT A.data_id ,A.subject ,A.url ,A.category_team ,crypto_dec('normal', user_name, '', 0) AS USER_NAME ,A.password ,A.email ,A.content ,A.hits ,A.board_code ,A.sub_category ,A.created_date ,A.target_option ,A.rel_option ,A.notice_flag ,A.visible_type ,A.seller_select_flag ,A.use_yn FROM ( SELECT data_id, subject, url, category_team, user_name, password, email, content, hits, board_code, sub_category, created_date, target_option, rel_option, notice_flag, visible_type, seller_select_flag, use_yn FROM OP_DATA_BOARD WHERE data_id = #{value} ) A
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OP_DATA_BOARD (DATA_ID, SUBJECT, URL, CATEGORY_TEAM, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, EMAIL, CONTENT, HITS, BOARD_CODE, SUB_CATEGORY, CREATED_DATE, TARGET_OPTION, REL_OPTION, NOTICE_FLAG, VISIBLE_TYPE, SELLER_SELECT_FLAG, USE_YN) VALUES (#{dataId}, #{subject}, #{url}, #{categoryTeam}, crypto_enc('normal', #{userName},''), #{password}, #{email}, #{content}, #{hits}, #{boardCode}, #{subCategory}, , #{targetOption}, #{relOption}, #{noticeFlag}, #{visibleType}, #{sellerSelectFlag}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE OP_DATA_BOARD SET SUBJECT = #{subject}, URL = #{url}, USER_NAME = crypto_enc('normal', #{userName},''), CONTENT = #{content}, TARGET_OPTION = #{targetOption}, REL_OPTION = #{relOption}, NOTICE_FLAG = #{noticeFlag}, VISIBLE_TYPE = #{visibleType}, SELLER_SELECT_FLAG = #{sellerSelectFlag}, USE_YN=#{useYn} WHERE DATA_ID = #{dataId}

mapper.select:
SELECT A.DATA_ID ,A.SUBJECT ,A.URL_TYPE ,A.CATEGORY_TEAM ,A.TARGET_OPTION ,A.REL_OPTION ,A.SUB_CATEGORY ,A.NOTICE_FLAG
,crypto_dec('normal',USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME ,A.PASSWORD ,A.EMAIL ,A.CONTENT ,A.HITS ,A.BOARD_CODE
,A.CREATED_DATE ,A.FILE_TY FROM ( SELECT D.DATA_ID, D.SUBJECT, CASE WHEN URL IS NULL OR URL = '' THEN CONCAT('/data-board/detail?dataId=',D.DATA_ID) ELSE TRIM(D.URL) END AS URL , CASE WHEN D.URL IS NULL OR D.URL = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS URL_TYPE , D.CATEGORY_TEAM, D.TARGET_OPTION, D.REL_OPTION, D.SUB_CATEGORY, D.NOTICE_FLAG,
D.USER_NAME, D.PASSWORD, D.EMAIL, D.CONTENT, D.HITS, D.BOARD_CODE,
D.CREATED_DATE, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(FILE_TY) FROM OP_DATA_BOARD_FILE WHERE DATA_ID = D.DATA_ID) AS FILE_TY FROM OP_DATA_BOARD D
ORDER BY IFNULL(D.NOTICE_FLAG, 'N') DESC , CASE WHEN IFNULL(D.NOTICE_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y' THEN D.DATA_ID ELSE 0 END DESC
, D.CREATED_DATE , D.HITS , D.CREATED_DATE
ASC DESC
, D.CREATED_DATE DESC
) A

/** databoard-mapper.getFrontDataboardFileDetail (자료실 파일 조회) */ SELECT DATA_FILE_ID, DATA_ID, FILE_NAME, FILE_TY, ORDERING, CREATED_DATE, ORG_FILE_NAME FROM OP_DATA_BOARD_FILE WHERE crypto_enc('normal', DATA_FILE_ID,'') = #{dataFileId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OP_DATA_BOARD_FILE WHERE crypto_enc('normal', DATA_FILE_ID,'') = #{dataFileId}
